rules.rule: Never cut price more than 8% in a single week
rules.reason: Protects brand perception and prevents panic pricing

rules.rule: Maintain minimum gross margin of 15% on all SKUs
rules.reason: Below this, unit economics break down

rules.rule: Do not cut prices during festival weeks or major sale events
rules.reason: Demand is inelastic during festivals; cutting wastes margin customers would have paid anyway

rules.rule: Do not match every competitor price cut automatically
rules.reason: Price wars erode category margin for everyone; evaluate case by case

rules.rule: Price changes should not repeat more than once per 7 days for the same SKU
rules.reason: Frequent repricing confuses customers and looks unstable

rules.rule: New product launches may use promotional pricing down to 8% below target margin for the first 4 weeks
rules.reason: Volume and reviews matter more than margin during launch

rules.rule: Flag as overstock risk when days-of-supply exceeds 45 days
rules.reason: Capital tied up in unsold inventory, storage cost accrues

rules.rule: Flag as stockout risk when days-of-supply falls below 7 days and lead time exceeds 5 days
rules.reason: Insufficient buffer to reorder before running out

rules.rule: Maintain minimum 14 days of safety stock for top 20% of SKUs by revenue
rules.reason: Best sellers should rarely go out of stock

rules.rule: Only approve inter-store transfers when ROI exceeds 20%
rules.reason: Transfer cost must be clearly justified by profit saved

rules.rule: Do not transfer stock if destination store's own reorder is arriving within 3 days
rules.reason: Unnecessary transfer cost if restock is already inbound

rules.rule: Any single decision affecting more than ₹50,000 in projected impact requires human approval
rules.reason: High-stakes decisions need a human in the loop

rules.rule: Any price increase above 10% requires human approval regardless of impact size
rules.reason: Large increases carry reputational risk beyond pure economics

rules.rule: Do not discount premium-tier SKUs by more than 5% under any circumstance
rules.reason: Premium positioning depends on price stability

rules.rule: Prefer bundling or value-adds over direct price cuts when clearing overstock
rules.reason: Bundling clears inventory without anchoring customers to a lower reference price
